newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close lower, ignoring U.S. rise.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close lower, ignoring U.S. rise.

text.p: Sweden's sharemarket closed lower on Monday, off the record highs hit last Friday, ignoring a rising U.S. market and depressed by drugs major Astra.
The Stockholm general index closed 0.11 percent lower at 2,055.38 after shares worth 3.0 billion crowns changed hands.
The market posted gains earlier in the day but in afternoon trade started slipping and did not respond when Wall Street opened higher.
"It is interesting that European bourses did not react when New York opened stronger," one broker said. "The next big move will be downwards."
Bluechip Astra was actively traded and closed lower which brokers attributed to much of the market weakness. Astra was 0.50 crown weaker at 286 crowns.
Dealers said there were a lot of rumours in the market about Astra being involved in a big deal in the U.S., maybe considering buying part of U.S. company AMI from Merck.
Telecoms giant Ericsson also slipped, closing 0.50 crowns lower to 165.50 crowns.
The banking sector was weaker after strong gains last week. The index slipped 0.07 percent.
